about: src/lib/menu_order_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file at this tag (madar-catalog order: the order a menu's categories are shown in, the POS's rule). features/public-ordering/menu-order.test.ts runs inMenuOrder (the wasm's category_order) against it. A change is made there, released with a tag, and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it.
